samples.summary: Todo checklist shows all Backend/CLI implementation items unchecked, but the code already exists in the tree
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260903-api-v1-folders-copy-todo.md lines under '### Backend' and '### CLI' are all '- [ ]' (unchecked), e.g. '- [ ] `api/v1/folders.controller.ts` — ...' and '- [ ] `folders` namespace (alias `folder`): `list` · `create` · `rename` · `move` · `delete`'. Verified against the working tree: packages/backend/src/api/v1/folders.controller.ts implements exactly this controller with the described guards and 404-not-403 behavior, packages/cli/src/commands/folders.ts implements the full folders CLI namespace, packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts implements `docs copy`/`docs move`, and packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts has entries for folders.list/create/rename/move/delete and docs.copy/docs.move. The checklist state understates progress relative to what has actually shipped in this same change.
